def solve(g):
    import numpy as np
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    fr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    fc=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    # horizontal band edges, vertical frame cols
    hrng=[(fr[i]+1,fr[i+1]-1) for i in range(len(fr)-1)]
    vc=[0]
    prev=-1
    for c in fc+[W]:
        if c>prev+1: vc.append((prev+1,c-1)); prev=c
    # bg color = frame color? determine frame color: value of row fr[0]
    fcol=g[fr[0]][fc[0]]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find filled shapes: connected components of nonzero non-frame cells not on frame rows/cols
    import collections
    def cell_ok(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]!=fcol and not(r in fr) and not(c in fc)
    seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool)
    comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if cell_ok(r,c) and not seen[r,c]:
                st=[(r,c)];seen[r,c]=True;comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if cell_ok(x,y) and not seen[x,y]: seen[x,y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps,vc,hrng,fcol

c1,vc1,hr1,f1=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print('d1 comps',[(len(c),min(p[0] for p in c),min(p[1] for p in c)) for c in c1])
c2,vc2,hr2,f2=solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])
print('d2 comps',[(len(c),min(p[0] for p in c),min(p[1] for p in c)) for c in c2])

import numpy as np
def bandlist(g):
    H,W=g.shape
    fr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    fc=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and g[0][c]!=0]
    def bands(f,N):
        bs=[];a=0
        for ff in f+[N]:
            if ff>a+1: bs.append((a,ff-1)); a=ff+1
        return bs

tfs={'rot90':lambda M:np.rot90(M,-1),'rot180':lambda M:np.rot90(M,2),'rot270':lambda M:np.rot90(M),'fliph':lambda M:M[:,::-1],'flipv':lambda M:M[::-1,:]}
def bandbox(ii):
    dr=[r for r in range(ii.shape[0]) if len(set(ii[r]))==1 and ii[r][0]!=0]
    dc=[c for c in range(ii.shape[1]) if len({ii[r][c] for r in range(ii.shape[0])})==1 and ii[0][c]!=0]
    rb=[0]+[d+1 for d in dr]; cb=[0]+[c+1 for c in dc]
    return {(i,j):ii[rb[i]:rb[i+1], cb[j]:cb[j+1]] for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)},dr,dc,rb,cb
def get(nm):
    a=np.array(G[nm+' input']); b=np.array(G[nm+' output'])

import numpy as np,json
def divlines(a):
    rL=[r for r in range(a.shape[0]) if len({int(v) for v in a[r]})==1 and int(a[r,0])!=0]
    cL=[c for c in range(a.shape[1]) if len({int(v) for v in a[:,c]})==1 and int(a[0,c])!=0]
    return rL,cL
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    a=np.array(G[nm+' input']); b=np.array(G[nm+' output'])
    rL,cL=divlines(a); print(nm,rL,cL,a.shape)
    rb=[(0,d-1) for d in rL]+[(rL[-1]+1,a.shape[0]-1)] if rL else [(0,a.shape[0]-1)]
    cb=[(0,d-1) for d in cL]+[(cL[-1]+1,a.shape[1]-1)] if cL else [(0,a.shape[1]-1)]
    print('bands',rb,cb)
    # changed cells: output nonzero where input zero
    chg=[(i,j) for i in range(a.shape[0]) for j in range(a.shape[1]) if a[i,j]==0 and b[i,j]!=0]
    print('changed',chg)

import numpy as np,json
def bandgrid(a):
    H,W=a.shape
    rL=[r for r in range(H) if len({int(v) for v in a[r]})==1 and a[r,0]!=0]
    cL=[c for c in range(W) if (a[:,c]==a[0,c]).all() and a[0,c]!=0]
    rb=[]; s=0
    for d in rL+[H]:
        if d>s: rb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    cb=[]; s=0
    for d in cL+[W]:
        if d>s: cb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    return rb,cb
ab=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); bb=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])

        row+= 'SRC' if (S!=0).any() else ('F' if ch else '.')

def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bands(A):
    H,W=A.shape
    rL=[r for r in range(H) if len({int(v) for v in A[r]})==1 and A[r,0]!=0]
    cL=[c for c in range(W) if (A[:,c]==A[0,c]).all() and A[0,c]!=0]
    rb=[]; s=0
    for d in rL+[H]:
        if d>s: rb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    cb=[]; s=0
    for d in cL+[W]:
        if d>s: cb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    return rb,cb
def f(A):
    A=np.array(A); O=A.copy()
    rb,cb=bands(A)
    rL=[r for r in range(A.shape[0]) if len({int(v) for v in A[r]})==1 and A[r,0]!=0]
    cL=[c for c in range(A.shape[1]) if (A[:,c]==A[0,c]).all() and A[0,c]!=0]
    # target bands: empty bands that share an edge-line with a nonempty band
    for bi in range(len(rb)):

            rs,re_=rb[bi]; cs,ce_=cb[bj]
            S=A[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]
            if (S!=0).any(): continue
            # vertical partner above
            if bi>0 and any(rL[k] for k in range(len(rL)) if rb[bi-1][1]<rL[k]<rs):
                src=A[rb[bi-1][0]:rb[bi-1][1]+1, cb[bj][0]:cb[bj][1]+1]
                Mt=src[::-1,:]  # mirror across horizontal divider
                dr = re_-rs+1 - Mt.shape[0]  # hang bottom-aligned so bottom edge abuts? try: image touches divider side of current band
                Tg=S.copy(); Tg[dr:dr+Mt.shape[0],:]=Mt
                O[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]=Tg
            if bi+1<len(rb) and any(rL[k] for k in range(len(rL)) if rb[bi+1][0]<rL[k]<re_):
                src=A[rb[bi+1][0]:rb[bi+1][1]+1, cb[bj][0]:cb[bj][1]+1]
                Mt=src[::-1,:]
                dr=0
                Tg=S.copy(); Tg[dr:dr+Mt.shape[0],:]=Mt
                O[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]=Tg
            for sj in [bj-1,bj+1]:
                if 0<=sj<len(cb) and any(cL[k] for k in range(len(cL)) if cb[sj][1]<cL[k]<cs):
                    src=A[rb[bi][0]:rb[bi][1]+1, cb[sj][0]:cb[sj][1]+1]

                    O[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]=Tg
    return O.tolist()

import numpy as np, os, re, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def analyze(A):
    A=np.array(A); H,W=A.shape
    rL=[r for r in range(H) if len({int(v) for v in A[r]})==1 and A[r,0]!=0]
    cL=[c for c in range(W) if (A[:,c]==A[0,c]).all() and A[0,c]!=0]
    rb=[]; s=0
    for d in rL+[H]:
        if d>s: rb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    cb=[]; s=0
    for d in cL+[W]:
        if d>s: cb.append((s,d-1)); s=d+1
    return rb,cb
# Determine correct geometric anchor by reconstructing exact outputs
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    A=np.array(G[nm+' input']); O=np.array(G[nm+' output'])
    rb,cb=analyze(A)
    print('===',nm,'===')
    for bi,(rs,re_) in enumerate(rb):
        for bj,(cs,ce_) in enumerate(cb):
            S=A[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]
            if not (S==0).any(): continue
            tgt=O[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]; inp=A[rs:re_+1,cs:ce_+1]
            h_,w_=tgt.shape
            res=None
            # try up: src above, flipud, anchored bottom of tgt touching divider (flipud of src: src bottom row closest divider -> target top)
            if bi>0 and cb[bi-1]==cb[bi]:
                Mt=S[::-1,:]
                arr=tgt.copy(); arr[:Mt.shape[0],:] = Mt
                res='up-top' if np.array_equal(tgt,arr) else None
            elif bi+1<len(rb) and cb[bi+1]==cb[bi]:
                Mt=S[::-1,:]
                arr=tgt.copy(); arr[-Mt.shape[0]:,:]=Mt
                res='down-bot' if np.array_equal(tgt,arr) else None
            if res: print(f'band({bi},{bj}) solved via {res}'); continue
            if bj>0 and rb[bi-1]==rb[bi]:
                Mt=S[:,::-1]; arr=tgt.copy(); arr[:,:Mt.shape[1]]=Mt
                res='left-l' if np.array_equal(tgt,arr) else None
            elif bj+1<len(cb) and rb[bi+1]==rb[bi]:
                Mt=S[:,::-1]; arr=tgt.copy(); arr[:,-Mt.shape[1]:]=Mt
                res='right-r' if np.array_equal(tgt,arr) else None
            print(f'band({bi},{bj}) unresolved via simple anchors, res={res}')

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bandcells(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    rl=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    cl=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    rb=[(0,rl[0]-1),(rl[0]+1,rl[1]-1),(rl[1]+1,rl[2]-1)]
    cb=[(0,cl[0]-1),(cl[0]+1,cl[1]-1),(cl[1]+1,cl[2]-1)]
    return rb,cb
def cell_of(g,i,j):
    rb,cb=bandcells(g)
    r0,r1=rb[i]; c0,c1=cb[j]
    return [[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
